title: A bill cut from a different manifest
change: bill.json names the July 2026 period statement (sha256:28260e54f2df89f55256fd9a4d3bdb449a3a7fd593b52e8d539d7102dac51a32, in other-manifest.json) as its manifest instead of the August one supplied. Its period and lines are unchanged.
why: Scope binding: the consumer refuses a bill whose manifest is not the one supplied and does not compare across scopes, so the bill is never compared with the receipts.
